Highlights:
## Acronis True Image OEM

## The software suite that can clone drives, backup your operating system, applications, settings and all of your data!

### Applicable product

- M.2 2280 PCIe® 4.0 NVMe SSD G series LE NN4LE
- M.2 2280 PCIe® 4.0 NVMe SSD G series NE1N
- M.2 2280 PCIe® 5.0 NVMe SSD X series
- M.2 2280 PCIe® 5.0 NVMe SSD NE5N series 

### Manual

- Users Guide – English
- Guide de l’utilisateur – Français
- Handbuch – Deutsch

- The Acronis True Image OEM download key is printed on the paper in the product package. If you lose the paper, it cannot be reissued. 
- For cloning, please prepare the required stuff such as M.2 case by yourself.
- The validity period is 1 year after the user activates.
